scope: Read-only source audit and ten narrow verification groups, refreshed after source-manifest helpers were appended; no project data was read or written and no full integration/model acceptance is claimed.

source.tree_hash_algorithm: SHA256(UTF-8 JSON sorted relative-path:SHA256 mapping; compact separators)

entity_registry.origin: Reconstructed from checked simulation.py loops and in-memory build_plan(); not a generated/exported data registry.
entity_registry.trip_identity_warning: Reused entity IDs do not mean 2026 trips are the same business events as 2025 trips; dataset/project identity must qualify cross-project trip joins.
entity_registry.facility_route_geometry_warning: The original route ring connects SITE-01→02 ... SITE-12→01 and is explicitly abstract_synthetic_route; original trip durations and distances were independently generated, so these are not road-network ETA ground truth.

seed_contract.rule: UTF-8 encoding of unit-separator joined str(seed,*tokens), SHA256 first 16 bytes as unsigned big-endian integer

reuse_decisions.detail: Preserve tenant/vehicle/device/driver/site/route IDs; regenerate all 2026 temporal versions and assignments. Registry enumerations are reconstructed from code, not an exported registry file.
Exact separator, UTF-8 encoding, SHA256 prefix128 and big-endian semantics retained. DS-M01 namespace prevents the new process from sharing DA-E01 random streams.
Same 1 MiB block strategy and resulting digest.

Sorted compact JSON preserved; explicit UTF-8 and allow_nan=False added. Source default=str and permissive NaN behavior are not carried forward. Write functions were not exercised by this read-only audit.
DS-M01 rejects naive timestamps and normalizes to UTC. Output formatting intentionally differs from canonical_utc microseconds format.
Original SQL quoting fixture passed. DS-M01 common.ident creates a hashed record ID and is a different API despite the shared name; do not substitute one for the other.

reuse_decisions.component: Snapshot-bound cursors and bounded retry/quarantine patterns
reuse_decisions.detail: Cursor pure functions checked; HTTP, event indexing, retry and quarantine integrations not rerun. ETA requires tenant/source-qualified event identity and ETA event tables.
Repeatable-read extraction, immutable keys and audit logging are patterns only. FUEL environment names, fuel table allowlists and schema bootstrap cannot be imported wholesale.

reuse_decisions.target: ETA explicit contract and feature allowlist
reuse_decisions.detail: The fuel canonical/analytics allowlists and contract path are incompatible. Prefix checks alone do not stop ETA outcome leakage.

reuse_decisions.component: DA-E01 physical generator, dates and fuel business logic
reuse_decisions.detail: 2025 constants, independent fuel distance/duration generation, fuel units and source cutoff are project-specific. Do not shift old timestamps and label the result as fresh observed data.
Packaged historical results are not a DS-M01 pass and were not counted as rerun checks.

reuse_decisions.source: DS-M01 implementation, not imported from DA-E01
reuse_decisions.detail: Writer compares persisted counts and records file SHA256 before replacing the manifest. Verifier compares raw source file hashes. compatibility_actions: Regenerate dates and entity assignment/version validity for the 2026 period.
Use explicit ETA source and feature allowlists; outcomes/truth must remain outside the feature boundary.
Keep stable entity IDs, project/dataset-qualified record identity and a distinct random namespace.
Treat 1,800 trips over nine months as lower sampling density than the old six-month design; do not claim equivalent month-level precision.
Rerun DS-M01-specific contract, temporal availability and leakage tests in M1/M2; this audit does not replace them.
